title: S&P downgrades Dream Finders to ’B+’ following $2.2B acquisition of Beazer Homes
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Jacksonville-based Dream Finders Homes Inc (NYSE:DFH) to 'B+' from 'BB-' following the completion of its $2.2 billion all-cash acquisition of Beazer Homes USA LLC. The credit rating agency cited an influx of deal-related debt and near-term macroeconomic pressures, even as the transaction substantially enhances the homebuilder's market scale and geographical reach.

title: Dream Finders Homes Completes Acquisition of Beazer Homes
summary: JACKSONVILLE, Fla., October 20, 2026--Dream Finders Homes, Inc. (NYSE: DFH) ("Dream Finders") today announced the completion of its acquisition of Beazer Homes USA, Inc. ("Beazer") in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise value of approximately $2.2 billion. Beazer shareholders received $33.50 in cash for each share of Beazer common stock. As a result of the completion of the acquisition, Beazer’s common stock ceased trading on and was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange.
